title: 1:1 prep — Michelle Zhou (report: Jordan Lee)
content:
Context: prep for recurring 1:1 with Jordan (IC, infra work on KV cache optimizations). Goal = unblock, align on next quarter priorities, career check-in, and confirm follow-ups.

Agenda:
- Quick personal check-in (5m): energy, workload, vacation planning
- Status updates (10m): current tasks, blockers, perf targets for KV cache work
- Design trade-offs (15m): rollout strategy for cache invalidation, canary plan, metrics to monitor
- Career/feedback (10m): growth areas, promotion readiness, mentoring needs
- Action items & next steps (5m)

Notes / talking points:
- Current sprint: finishing RFC for cache invalidation strategy (RFC link in GH-PR-847). On track for EOW but need final perf numbers from microbench pipeline.
- Metrics:  p50 latency for hot-path currently 48ms (target 35ms), p95 210ms. Hypothesis: KV cache misses + model warmup are main contributors. Need to confirm with tracing. Tagged traces LIN-4021.
- Blocker: infra quota for microbench cluster — awaiting quota bump from infra provisioning (ticket LIN-3987). Estimate delay 3 business days unless we temporarily run on dedicated CI with smaller shards. Discuss tradeoffs.
- Rollout: propose phased canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with automatic rollback on p95 > 300ms or error rate >0.5%. Need SRE sign-off; ask Jordan if he can pair with SRE lead this week.
- Safety: ensure cache invalidation handles cross-region coherence — note from prior doc: edge-case where stale KV persisted for 90s; mitigation: add tombstone + short TTL for keys updated by model.

Career/feedback items to bring up:
- Jordan expressed interest in stepping into tech lead responsibilities for the KV cache area. Discuss expectations, visible leadership (design docs, PR reviews), and time allocation.
- Suggest a 6-week plan: own rollout plan, lead postmortem template, mentor one junior engineer (Ava Chen recommended).
- Promotion readiness: checklist items (impact, scope, mentorship, documentation). Recommend we finalize checklist and set target for end of Q2.

Questions to ask Jordan:
- Do you feel you have the time to take on TL duties without blocking sprint commitments? If not, what should we deprioritize?
- Are there any infra or tooling gaps blocking your velocity (observability, test infra, perf harness)?
- Which project would you like to own next quarter? (options: cache rollout, model-variant routing, quantization evaluation)

Proposed action items (record in 1:1 follow-up):
- Jordan: run full microbench with new kernel selection (due 2026-03-06) — add results to LIN-4021.
- Michelle: follow up with infra provisioning for quota bump (LIN-3987) and propose temporary CI plan by 2026-03-04.
- Michelle + Jordan: draft canary rollout plan and alert thresholds, share with SRE for review by 2026-03-05 (linked GH-PR-847).
- Jordan: identify mentee and draft 6-week TL ramp plan by 2026-03-10.
- Michelle: schedule 30m sync with SRE lead (Avery Brooks) to confirm rollback hooks — target 2026-03-04.

Open / parking-lot items (to revisit in next 1:1):
- Long-term ownership of model variant routing policy (decide team lead before end of Q2)
- Formal promotion evidence doc (start draft after 6-week ramp)

Quick wins to offer this week:
- I can unblock temporary CI capacity (small shards) so Jordan can finish microbench sooner.
- Offer to review the RFC early — will schedule 1 hour review slot.

Post-meeting checklist (what I will do right after 1:1):
1) Send follow-up email with agreed action items and deadlines.
2) Create/update Linear tasks: LIN-4021 (bench results), LIN-4033 (canary plan review), LIN-4034 (SRE sync).
3) Ping infra owner for quota update and confirm ETA.
4) Add promotion checklist template to shared doc and invite Jordan to collaborate.

Misc notes / phrases to capture during meeting:
- "Are you blocked on anything I can remove?"
- "What would you like more of from me (reviews, context, 1:1 focus)?"
- "If you were running this project, what's your rollback playbook?"

Draft follow-up email summary (copy to use):
Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the sync — appreciate the status and context. Per our convo: lin items & owners below. Please ping if I've missed anything.

Action items:
- Jordan: microbench run with new kernel selection — due 2026-03-06 (LIN-4021)
- Michelle: infra quota follow-up & temporary CI plan — due 2026-03-04 (LIN-3987)
- Michelle + Jordan: canary rollout plan -> SRE review — due 2026-03-05 (GH-PR-847 / LIN-4033)
- Jordan: TL ramp plan & mentee identified — due 2026-03-10

Thanks,
Michelle
